title: Fixed the context menu throwing under a Content Security Policy that enforces Trusted Types (`require-trusted-types-for 'script'`) when an item showed a check mark, which happened for "Read only", "Read-only comment", and any border already applied to the selection. The mark was built as an HTML string and written through `innerHTML`; it is now built as a DOM node, so the menu needs no Trusted Types policy and no `sanitizer`. Those items are also announced to assistive technology as checkboxes now, so their state is read out and not only drawn.
